sprint_goal: Site Audit Module (Pipeline 0) — production-grade 6-step deterministic website audit across 8 dimensions (crawlability, performance, on-page SEO, extractability/AEO, schema markup, E-E-A-T, freshness, security). 100% deterministic — no LLM calls. Built by 4-teammate agent team (architect, crawler, analyzers, api-service).
sprint_status: COMPLETE — 636 new site audit tests. ~1850+ total collected.
constraints: Backward compatibility with existing artifacts
All Pydantic fields must have defaults
Raw SDK clients for LLM calls (no LangChain wrappers)
LangGraph >=1.0 interrupt model: check __interrupt__ in result dict, not GraphInterrupt exception
Frontend renders its own charts from raw JSON (not iframes)
No Supabase yet — filesystem artifacts are source of truth
email-validator required for auth models (EmailStr)
Password min_length=8, max_length=128 enforced in LoginRequest and RegisterRequest
Double-underscore separator for effective slugs: {company}__{product}
Prompt product context only when product_slug AND product_name both set
Default-deny middleware — all routes protected unless explicitly whitelisted
Registration creates isolated companies only — domain auto-join removed (Codex C1)
JWT_SECRET_KEY required in non-dev/test environments (Codex W8)
core/ cannot import from api/ — shared code goes in core/shared_tools/
DB layer is opt-in via DATABASE_URL — no engine creation at import time
Repos flush only, DI session generator owns commit/rollback
Native PgUUID(as_uuid=True) for PKs — repo layer handles str<->uuid conversion
AuthServiceProtocol is the contract — all routers use get_auth_service dependency
Middleware uses verify_token utility + app.state.secret_key (no AuthStore dependency)
Service protocols are the contract — routers use get_*_data_service dependencies
JsonService is default, DbService is opt-in via DATABASE_URL + db_session_factory
TaskStoreProtocol is the contract — all routers/runners use get_task_store dependency
DbTaskStore is opt-in via DATABASE_URL — JSON TaskStore is fallback on init failure
